allow: PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "CommandLine LIKE '%ts-node-dev%'" | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; Write-Output "cleaned")
Bash(powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000,5173,5433 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort,OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\);process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{const j=JSON.parse\(d\); const list=j.data||j; const p=list.filter\(a=>a.name==='QA Playwright Patient'\); console.log\(p.map\(a=>\({name:a.name,birthDate:a.birthDate}\)\)\)}\)")

Bash(node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on\('data',c=>d+=c\);process.stdin.on\('end',\(\)=>{const j=JSON.parse\(d\); const list=j.data||j; console.log\('Total:', list.length\); const nulls = list.filter\(a=>a.height==null||a.weight==null||a.sport==null\); console.log\('Con height/weight/sport null:', nulls.length\); console.log\(nulls.map\(a=>\({id:a.id,name:a.name,height:a.height,weight:a.weight,sport:a.sport,patientType:a.patientType}\)\)\)}\)")
